market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from energy-driven inflation and Fed hike expectations. Dow's 500-point bounce is likely a relief rally, not trend reversal. Oil volatility ($102-108 range) will dominate. CPI data and Fed commentary are critical. Expect 5-8% volatility in equities. Crypto remains under pressure. Energy and defense outperform; consumer discretionary and housing lag.
market_outlook.long_term: Higher-for-longer rates become structural, compressing growth multiples. Energy transition accelerates (Europe solar storage problem, construction automation). AI infrastructure capex continues but application-layer consolidation likely. Geopolitical fragmentation (BRICS vs. West) creates trade diversification opportunities. Space economy enters commercial phase. Consumer spending remains constrained for 2-3 quarters.
